title: Tale of Wuxia
provenance: Reported by w8079 (highball-db#352, 2026-10-06), Apple M4, macOS 27.0.1, the Steam release v1.0.3.1, rated 2 of 5: menus over 100 fps, maps about 4.4 fps on engines x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r19 and r21 in DXMT mode, about 45 fps on the Wine 11 engine r19 in DXVK mode with the third-party x87 sidecar v1.8.0 attached (hook confirmed in the log). Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Menus are fast, maps crawl. The player's samples put the busy thread in the game's x87 floating-point code, which Rosetta translates slowly.

knownIssues.symptom: Maps run at about 4 fps while menus run at 100 fps or more
knownIssues.cause: the game's x87 floating-point code runs slowly under Rosetta (winedbg samples in highball-db#352)
knownIssues.fix: Highball 0.10.26's Wine 11 engines r30 and r31 carry athei's x87 sidecar. Put the environment on one of them, add HB_X87SIDECAR=1 to its variables and use DXVK, the mode of the player's 45 fps. That measurement was made with sidecar v1.8.0 set up by hand on r19, not yet with the copy the engines ship. On the Wine 11 engines DXMT mode hands Direct3D 9 to Wine's own implementation, which wasn't measured
